sources.title: Vision Transformer (ViT) · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model was published in HF papers on 2020-10-22 and contributed to Hugging Face Transformers on 2021-04-01. Copy page Vision Transformer (ViT) Vision Transformer (ViT)is a transformer adapted for computer vision tasks. An image is split into smaller fixed-sized patches which are treated as a sequence of tokens, similar to words for NLP tasks.
